records.text: A 23-year-old Oxford student whom Aleister Crowley regarded as his magical heir went to Sicily with him and died
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This was a 23-year-old student, okay? Aleister Crowley thinks he has. The it factor, they go down to Sicily, and the kid ends up dead.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Historical sources identify 23-year-old Oxford undergraduate Raoul Loveday as a Crowley follower who went to the Abbey of Thelema in Sicily and died there in 1923.

sources.title: Rethinking Aleister Crowley and Thelema
sources.relevance: Scholarly account of Crowley's Abbey and Raoul Loveday.
